# Custom wiki image with sessionless security
FROM dobbs/farm:latest

# Switch to root for global npm install
USER root

# Install wiki-security-sessionless globally for sessionless authentication
# This enables authentication using secp256k1 keypairs instead of traditional sessions
# Works with owner.json file containing pubKey for verification
# Installed globally so it persists even when /home/node/.wiki is mounted
RUN npm install -g wiki-security-sessionless

# Switch back to node user for runtime
USER node

# Note: Wiki plugins will be added later via other mechanisms
# This image only provides the base wiki + sessionless security

WORKDIR /home/node/.wiki

# Expose wiki port
EXPOSE 3000

# Start wiki in farm mode with friends security
# Sessionless authentication is enabled via wiki-security-sessionless module
CMD ["wiki", "--farm", "--autoseed", "--security_type=friends"]
